questions.questionHtml:
⚡ GO Classes CS 2027 Style | Network Layer

A router has the following CIDR routing table entries:
1. `128.16.0.0/16` $\to$ Interface 0
2. `128.16.128.0/17` $\to$ Interface 1
3. `128.16.192.0/18` $\to$ Interface 2
4. `default` $\to$ Interface 3
Which interface will a packet with destination IP address `128.16.200.1` be forwarded to?

💡 Official Solution & Step-by-Step Derivation:
Address: `128.16.200.1`. In binary, 3rd octet $200 = 11001000_2$.
- `/16`: matches.
- `/17` (`128.16.128.0` has 1st bit of 3rd octet = 1): matches.
- `/18` (`128.16.192.0` has first two bits of 3rd octet = $11_2$): matches since $200 = 11001000_2$.
By Longest Prefix Match, the router selects the longest prefix `/18` $\to$ Interface 2.

⚡ GO Classes CS 2027 Style | Data Link Layer

A 100 Mbps CSMA/CD network has a cable length of 1 km with signal propagation speed of $2 \times 10^8$ m/s. What is the minimum frame size (in bytes) required to detect collisions reliably?

💡 Official Solution & Step-by-Step Derivation:
Propagation delay $T_p = \frac{\text{Distance}}{\text{Speed}} = \frac{1000}{2 \times 10^8} = 5 \times 10^{-6}$ s $= 5\;\mu$s.
CSMA/CD condition: Transmission time $T_t \ge 2 T_p \implies \frac{L}{B} \ge 2 T_p \implies L \ge 2 \times 5 \times 10^{-6} \times 100 \times 10^6 = 1000$ bits.
Frame size in bytes $= 1000 / 8 = 125$ bytes.

⚡ GO Classes CS 2027 Style | Transport Layer

Which of the following events causes TCP Reno to set its Slow Start Threshold (`ssthresh`) to half of the current congestion window size?

💡 Official Solution & Step-by-Step Derivation:
Both on triple duplicate ACKs (loss indication) and retransmission timeout (severe congestion), TCP Reno reduces `ssthresh = cwnd / 2`. During normal ACK reception, `cwnd` increases, not `ssthresh`.

questions.questionHtml:
⚡ GO Classes CS 2027 Style | Application Layer

Standard DNS lookup queries sent by a client resolver to a local recursive DNS server predominantly use which transport layer protocol?

💡 Official Solution & Step-by-Step Derivation:
Standard DNS queries use UDP port 53 due to low latency and single request-response nature. TCP port 53 is used for zone transfers or responses exceeding 512 bytes.

⚡ GO Classes CS 2027 Style | Network Layer

In an IPv4 packet header without options, the total header length is represented by an IHL field value of:

💡 Official Solution & Step-by-Step Derivation:
The minimum IPv4 header is 20 bytes. The Internet Header Length (IHL) field counts the header size in 32-bit (4-byte) words. Thus $\text{IHL} = 20 / 4 = 5$.

⚡ GO Classes CS 2027 Style | Routing Protocols

Which mechanism is specifically designed to alleviate the count-to-infinity problem in Distance Vector Routing (Bellman-Ford)?

💡 Official Solution & Step-by-Step Derivation:
Split horizon with poison reverse prevents routing loops between adjacent neighbors by advertising an infinite metric ($\infty$) back on the interface from which the route was learned.

questions.questionHtml:
⚡ GO Classes CS 2027 Style | Data Link Layer

A Selective Repeat sliding window protocol uses a 4-bit sequence number field. What is the maximum allowable window size for both sender and receiver to prevent duplicate packet confusion?

💡 Official Solution & Step-by-Step Derivation:
In Selective Repeat, the sender and receiver windows must satisfy $W_s + W_r \le 2^k$. With $W_s = W_r$, $2W \le 2^k \implies W \le 2^{k-1}$. For $k=4$ bits: $W_{\max} = 2^{4-1} = 2^3 = 8$.

questions.questionHtml:
⚡ GO Classes CS 2027 Style | Flow Control

In a Stop-and-Wait protocol, frame transmission time is 1 ms and round-trip propagation time is 9 ms. Processing and ACK times are negligible. What is the link utilization efficiency (in %)?

💡 Official Solution & Step-by-Step Derivation:
Efficiency $\eta = \frac{T_t}{T_t + RTT} = \frac{1}{1 + 9} = \frac{1}{10} = 10\%$.

⚡ GO Classes CS 2027 Style | Transport Layer

A SYN Flood attack exploits which stage of the TCP connection lifecycle?

💡 Official Solution & Step-by-Step Derivation:
SYN flood sends a barrage of TCP SYN packets with spoofed source IPs without completing the 3rd ACK, exhausting the server's embryonic connection backlog queue (SYN queue).

questions.questionHtml:
⚡ GO Classes CS 2027 Style | Network Layer

An IPv4 datagram carrying 4000 bytes of data (plus 20 bytes IP header) passes through a link with MTU = 1500 bytes. What is the fragment offset value in the second fragment?

💡 Official Solution & Step-by-Step Derivation:
MTU = 1500 bytes. With 20-byte IP header, max payload per fragment is 1480 bytes (which is divisible by 8: $1480 / 8 = 185$).
- First fragment carries data bytes 0 to 1479 (offset = 0).
- Second fragment carries data starting at byte 1480. Fragment offset $= 1480 / 8 = 185$.

⚡ GO Classes CS 2027 Style | Address Resolution Protocol

The Address Resolution Protocol (ARP) operates at which conceptual boundary and scope?

💡 Official Solution & Step-by-Step Derivation:
ARP broadcasts on the local link layer (Layer 2) to discover the 48-bit MAC address corresponding to a given 32-bit IPv4 address on the same local subnet.

questions.questionHtml:
⚡ GO Classes CS 2027 Style | Network Layer

How many total IP addresses are contained in the CIDR subnet block `172.16.0.0/22`?

💡 Official Solution & Step-by-Step Derivation:
Subnet mask prefix length is 22. Number of host bits $= 32 - 22 = 10$. Total IP addresses $= 2^{10} = 1024$.

⚡ GO Classes CS 2027 Style | Transport Layer

Which algorithm is implemented at the sender side to prevent the Silly Window Syndrome in TCP?

💡 Official Solution & Step-by-Step Derivation:
Nagle's algorithm operates on the sender side to delay transmission until a full MSS is available or all outstanding data is acknowledged. Clark's solution is receiver-side.
